# Canonical Synthetic Journal Dataset

This directory contains only fictional, non-customer accounting scenarios used
to test vendor-neutral conversion invariants and adapter contracts.

Cases:

- C-001 simple journal
- C-002 description
- C-003 subaccount
- C-004 department
- C-005 tax
- C-006 invoice classification
- C-007 compound debit
- C-008 compound credit
- C-009 many-to-many compound
- C-010 quoted comma
- C-011 Japanese full-width characters
- C-012 zero amount invalid case
- C-013 negative/invalid amount
- C-014 unknown master
- C-015 maximum-length boundary
- C-016 duplicate-content journals

The dataset is intentionally synthetic. Do not copy real customer CSV files here.
